body:
## Change

F1. Combine caller cancellation with prepared-release lifetime for optional media reads. Disposal marks in-flight reads aborted; production reader can stop at its next abort checkpoint. Preserve null-on-disposal and caller-abort behavior.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN verifies actual adapter passes an aborted signal to controlled read transport. Parent reviewed acquire/dispose/queue paths and production responseBytes abort checks; reran 1 regression plus 36 progressive-storage tests. Worker related: 76; boundaries: 52, typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Cache.match or a pending stream read is not synchronously interrupted by this signal; cancellation takes effect at existing reader checkpoints. Focused fixture verifies signal propagation, not native transport resource reclamation timing. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(content): signal cancellation when release is disposed
